Article 1

1. Government is the Central Government. 2. Region is Bantul Regency. 3. Regional Government is the Regent and Regional Apparatus as elements of regional government administration. 4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bantul Regency as an element of Regional Government administration. 5. Regent is the Regent of Bantul. 6. Regional Apparatus Work Unit hereinafter abbreviated as SKPD, is the regional apparatus work unit of Bantul Regency. 7. Woman is a person who is female by sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman. 8. Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age, including a child still in the womb. 9. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, and psychological, threat of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life against the victim. 10. Violence against women is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life. 11. Violence against children is any act that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, psychologically, sexually, neglect, exploitation, economically, and other violence. 12. Physical Violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and or causes death. 13. Psychological Violence is any act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person. 14. Sexual Violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse in an unnatural or unwanted manner, forced sexual intercourse with others for commercial purposes and or certain purposes. 15. Economic Violence is any act that neglects family members in the form of not providing proper living care or maintenance. 16. Exploitation of Children is any act involving children in activities that may harm their welfare and development or endanger the safety of children with the aim of enabling others to obtain economic, sexual, social, or political benefits, including if it contains restrictions or elimination of opportunities for children to obtain their rights. 17. Sexual harassment is any action with sexual nuances conveyed through physical or non-physical contact that targets sexual body parts or a person's sexuality, including by using whistles, winking, comments or sexually nuanced speech, displaying pornographic materials and sexual desires, pinching or touching body parts, movements or gestures that are sexual in nature resulting in feelings of discomfort, offense, feeling degraded in dignity, and possibly causing health and safety problems. 18. Victim is a Child and Woman who experiences misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence occurring in the Bantul Regency area. 19. Prevention is a direct effort carried out by the Regional Government to prevent acts of violence against women and children. 20. Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center. 21. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security for women carried out by family members, the police, prosecutors, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred. 22. Protection of children is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination. 23. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred. 24. Women's Empowerment is any effort to improve physical, mental, spiritual, social abilities, knowledge, and skills so that women are ready to be utilized according to their respective abilities. 25. Companion is a person or representative from an institution who has expertise in accompanying victims to conduct counseling, therapy and advocacy for strengthening and recovery of victims of violence. 26. Spiritual guidance is assistance in the form of services for spiritual strengthening so that sick people can rise to be closer to God so that a sense of calm, security arises, and mental health is achieved. 27. Judicial body is a general court that has the authority to receive, examine, and adjudicate, as well as resolve every case submitted to it, to realize law enforcement and justice. 28. Prosecution is the action of the public prosecutor to transfer a case to the competent district court in the manner and according to the procedure regulated in the law with a request to be examined and decided by a judge in a court session. 29. Lawsuit is a notification accompanied by a request by an interested party to a judge to take action according to law against a person who has harmed him in a civil manner. 30. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organization (NGO) that provides assistance to victims of violence. 31. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT is a functional work unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence. 32. Regional Action Plan is the foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the prevention and protection of children and women victims of violence. 33.

Article 13

1. In order to provide services and protection to victims of acts of violence, the Regional Government establishes PPT.
2. PPT as referred to in paragraph (1) has the duties, main tasks, and functions of providing protection to Children and Women from acts of violence, consisting of fields.
3. PPT as referred to in paragraph (1) is tasked with providing services and protection to children and women victims of violence.
4. In the event that PPT does not have facilities to provide services and protection as referred to in paragraph (3), then children and women victims of violence are referred through a network system within the FPKK framework.
5. PPT as referred to in paragraph (1) is stipulated by Regent Regulation.

Article 3

Paragraph (1) Sufficiently clear.

Paragraph (2) Sufficiently clear.

Paragraph (3) Letter a What is meant by the "prevention" aspect is a protection strategy effort through:

a. Primary prevention, all people, families, communities and the state in efforts to increase knowledge capacity, understanding and ensure that violence against women and children does not occur, including policy socialization, adequate services, supportive workplace policies, and life skills training for women and children. What is meant by life skills training includes conflict resolution without violence, stress management skills, resource management, effective decision making, effective interpersonal communication, guidance on psychosocial development of women and children.

4 2015
b. Secondary prevention, aimed at community groups at high risk in efforts to improve skills, including training and victim services to ensure that violence against women and children does not occur in the next generation.

Activities carried out here include conducting home visits for parents who have just had children to conduct self-assessment of whether they are at risk of committing violence against children in the future.

c. Tertiary prevention, intended to improve parenting capacity that ensures violence against women and children is not repeated, what is done here is integrated services for women and children who are victims of violence, through counseling, stress management training.

Letter b What is meant by the "service and assistance" aspect is immediate activities and actions carried out by professionals and assistants in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.

Letter c Sufficiently clear.

Letter d What is meant by the "empowerment" aspect is the process of increasing the role of the community to participate in the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence which aims to obtain access and participation in the protection process for women and children broadly.

5 2015 Item 4

Article 25

Paragraph (1) Sufficiently clear Paragraph (2) Point a What is meant by "network" includes family partners, dasawisma, family groups that exist in the community.

What is meant by "coordination" includes planning, implementation and monitoring of violence prevention programs.

Point b What is meant by "violence prevention system" includes mapping of locations or areas prone to violence and carrying out promotive and preventive efforts to the community.

7 2015 Point c What is meant by "Critical education about the rights of children and women" is an effort to build awareness of children and women about their rights.

The purpose of implementing critical education is to be able to help decisions and not become victims of repeated violence.

Forms of critical education for the community consist of: training on gender equality and justice, education on reproductive health for women, and providing understanding of laws and regulations on the Elimination of Domestic Violence and Child Protection.

Point d Socialization can be carried out through mass media, electronic media, and direct counseling to the community.

Number 15

I. GENERAL

As a manifestation of the Regional Government's responsibility in taking actions both legally, politically, economically and socially to prevent, suppress, reduce, and eliminate all forms of violence against children and women, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence has been established.

Until now, the said Regional Regulation has been implemented in the administration of regional government. However, in accordance with the supervision mechanism for regional legal products, the Regional Government of the Special Region of Yogyakarta has provided clarification on Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence. From the results of said clarification, there are several substantive changes that must be followed up with an Amendment to the Regional Regulation.

2 2015 Based on the aforementioned considerations, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence needs to be amended in its Articles and elucidation.

40. Letter a What is meant by "respect and fulfillment of victims' rights" is a series of actions to respect, appreciate and ensure the fulfillment of victims' rights.

I. GENERAL

As a manifestation of the Regional Government's responsibility in taking actions both legally, politically, economically and socially to prevent, suppress, reduce, and eliminate all forms of violence against children and women, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence has been established.

Until now, the said Regional Regulation has been implemented in the administration of regional government. However, in accordance with the supervision mechanism for regional legal products, the Regional Government of the Special Region of Yogyakarta has provided clarification on Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence. From the results of said clarification, there are several substantive changes that must be followed up with an Amendment to the Regional Regulation.

2 2015 Based on the aforementioned considerations, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence needs to be amended in its Articles and elucidation.

Paragraph (1) Sufficiently clear.

Primary prevention, all people, families, communities and the state in efforts to increase knowledge capacity, understanding and ensure that violence against women and children does not occur, including policy socialization, adequate services, supportive workplace policies, and life skills training for women and children. b. Secondary prevention, aimed at community groups at high risk in efforts to improve skills, including training and victim services to ensure that violence against women and children does not occur in the next generation.

I. GENERAL

As a manifestation of the Regional Government's responsibility in taking actions both legally, politically, economically and socially to prevent, suppress, reduce, and eliminate all forms of violence against children and women, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence has been established.

Until now, the said Regional Regulation has been implemented in the administration of regional government. However, in accordance with the supervision mechanism for regional legal products, the Regional Government of the Special Region of Yogyakarta has provided clarification on Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence. 2 2015 Based on the aforementioned considerations, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence needs to be amended in its Articles and elucidation.

I. GENERAL

As a manifestation of the Regional Government's responsibility in taking actions both legally, politically, economically and socially to prevent, suppress, reduce, and eliminate all forms of violence against children and women, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence has been established.

Until now, the said Regional Regulation has been implemented in the administration of regional government. However, in accordance with the supervision mechanism for regional legal products, the Regional Government of the Special Region of Yogyakarta has provided clarification on Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence. From the results of said clarification, there are several substantive changes that must be followed up with an Amendment to the Regional Regulation.

2 2015 Based on the aforementioned considerations, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence needs to be amended in its Articles and elucidation.

As a manifestation of the Regional Government's responsibility in taking actions both legally, politically, economically and socially to prevent, suppress, reduce, and eliminate all forms of violence against children and women, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence has been established.

Woman is a person who is female by sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman. 8. Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age, including a child still in the womb. 9. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, and psychological, threat of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life against the victim. 10. Violence against women is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life. 11. Violence against children is any act that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, psychologically, sexually, neglect, exploitation, economically, and other violence. 12. Psychological Violence is any act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person. 14. Sexual Violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse in an unnatural or unwanted manner, forced sexual intercourse with others for commercial purposes and or certain purposes. 15. Victim is a Child and Woman who experiences misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence occurring in the Bantul Regency area. 19. Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center. 21. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security for women carried out by family members, the police, prosecutors, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred. 22. Protection of children is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination. 23. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred. 24. Women's Empowerment is any effort to improve physical, mental, spiritual, social abilities, knowledge, and skills so that women are ready to be utilized according to their respective abilities. 25. Companion is a person or representative from an institution who has expertise in accompanying victims to conduct counseling, therapy and advocacy for strengthening and recovery of victims of violence. 26. Spiritual guidance is assistance in the form of services for spiritual strengthening so that sick people can rise to be closer to God so that a sense of calm, security arises, and mental health is achieved. 27. Judicial body is a general court that has the authority to receive, examine, and adjudicate, as well as resolve every case submitted to it, to realize law enforcement and justice. 28. Prosecution is the action of the public prosecutor to transfer a case to the competent district court in the manner and according to the procedure regulated in the law with a request to be examined and decided by a judge in a court session. 29. Lawsuit is a notification accompanied by a request by an interested party to a judge to take action according to law against a person who has harmed him in a civil manner. 30. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organization (NGO) that provides assistance to victims of violence. 31. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT is a functional work unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence. 32. Regional Action Plan is the foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the prevention and protection of children and women victims of violence. 33.

Article 13

I. GENERAL

As a manifestation of the Regional Government's responsibility in taking actions both legally, politically, economically and socially to prevent, suppress, reduce, and eliminate all forms of violence against children and women, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence has been established.

Until now, the said Regional Regulation has been implemented in the administration of regional government. However, in accordance with the supervision mechanism for regional legal products, the Regional Government of the Special Region of Yogyakarta has provided clarification on Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence. From the results of said clarification, there are several substantive changes that must be followed up with an Amendment to the Regional Regulation.

2 2015 Based on the aforementioned considerations, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence needs to be amended in its Articles and elucidation.

CONCERNING

I. GENERAL

As a manifestation of the Regional Government's responsibility in taking actions both legally, politically, economically and socially to prevent, suppress, reduce, and eliminate all forms of violence against children and women, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence has been established.

Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bantul Regency as an element of Regional Government administration. 5. Regent is the Regent of Bantul. 6. Regional Apparatus Work Unit hereinafter abbreviated as SKPD, is the regional apparatus work unit of Bantul Regency. 7. Woman is a person who is female by sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman. 8. Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age, including a child still in the womb. 9. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, and psychological, threat of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life against the victim. 10. Violence against women is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life. 11. Violence against children is any act that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, psychologically, sexually, neglect, exploitation, economically, and other violence. 12. Physical Violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and or causes death. 13. Psychological Violence is any act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person. 14. Sexual Violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse in an unnatural or unwanted manner, forced sexual intercourse with others for commercial purposes and or certain purposes. 15. Economic Violence is any act that neglects family members in the form of not providing proper living care or maintenance. 16. Exploitation of Children is any act involving children in activities that may harm their welfare and development or endanger the safety of children with the aim of enabling others to obtain economic, sexual, social, or political benefits, including if it contains restrictions or elimination of opportunities for children to obtain their rights. 17. Sexual harassment is any action with sexual nuances conveyed through physical or non-physical contact that targets sexual body parts or a person's sexuality, including by using whistles, winking, comments or sexually nuanced speech, displaying pornographic materials and sexual desires, pinching or touching body parts, movements or gestures that are sexual in nature resulting in feelings of discomfort, offense, feeling degraded in dignity, and possibly causing health and safety problems. 18. Victim is a Child and Woman who experiences misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence occurring in the Bantul Regency area. 19. Prevention is a direct effort carried out by the Regional Government to prevent acts of violence against women and children. 20. Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center. 21. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security for women carried out by family members, the police, prosecutors, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred. 22. Protection of children is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination. 23. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred. 24. Women's Empowerment is any effort to improve physical, mental, spiritual, social abilities, knowledge, and skills so that women are ready to be utilized according to their respective abilities. 25. Companion is a person or representative from an institution who has expertise in accompanying victims to conduct counseling, therapy and advocacy for strengthening and recovery of victims of violence. 26. Spiritual guidance is assistance in the form of services for spiritual strengthening so that sick people can rise to be closer to God so that a sense of calm, security arises, and mental health is achieved. 27. Judicial body is a general court that has the authority to receive, examine, and adjudicate, as well as resolve every case submitted to it, to realize law enforcement and justice. 28. Prosecution is the action of the public prosecutor to transfer a case to the competent district court in the manner and according to the procedure regulated in the law with a request to be examined and decided by a judge in a court session. 29. Lawsuit is a notification accompanied by a request by an interested party to a judge to take action according to law against a person who has harmed him in a civil manner. 30. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organization (NGO) that provides assistance to victims of violence. 31. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT is a functional work unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence. 32. Regional Action Plan is the foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the prevention and protection of children and women victims of violence. 33.

Article 1

Sufficiently clear Item 2

I. GENERAL

As a manifestation of the Regional Government's responsibility in taking actions both legally, politically, economically and socially to prevent, suppress, reduce, and eliminate all forms of violence against children and women, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence has been established.

Until now, the said Regional Regulation has been implemented in the administration of regional government. However, in accordance with the supervision mechanism for regional legal products, the Regional Government of the Special Region of Yogyakarta has provided clarification on Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence. From the results of said clarification, there are several substantive changes that must be followed up with an Amendment to the Regional Regulation.

2 2015 Based on the aforementioned considerations, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence needs to be amended in its Articles and elucidation.

I. GENERAL

As a manifestation of the Regional Government's responsibility in taking actions both legally, politically, economically and socially to prevent, suppress, reduce, and eliminate all forms of violence against children and women, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence has been established.

I. GENERAL

As a manifestation of the Regional Government's responsibility in taking actions both legally, politically, economically and socially to prevent, suppress, reduce, and eliminate all forms of violence against children and women, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence has been established.

Until now, the said Regional Regulation has been implemented in the administration of regional government. However, in accordance with the supervision mechanism for regional legal products, the Regional Government of the Special Region of Yogyakarta has provided clarification on Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence. From the results of said clarification, there are several substantive changes that must be followed up with an Amendment to the Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL

As a manifestation of the Regional Government's responsibility in taking actions both legally, politically, economically and socially to prevent, suppress, reduce, and eliminate all forms of violence against children and women, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence has been established.

Until now, the said Regional Regulation has been implemented in the administration of regional government. However, in accordance with the supervision mechanism for regional legal products, the Regional Government of the Special Region of Yogyakarta has provided clarification on Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence. From the results of said clarification, there are several substantive changes that must be followed up with an Amendment to the Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL

As a manifestation of the Regional Government's responsibility in taking actions both legally, politically, economically and socially to prevent, suppress, reduce, and eliminate all forms of violence against children and women, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence has been established.

Until now, the said Regional Regulation has been implemented in the administration of regional government. However, in accordance with the supervision mechanism for regional legal products, the Regional Government of the Special Region of Yogyakarta has provided clarification on Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence. From the results of said clarification, there are several substantive changes that must be followed up with an Amendment to the Regional Regulation.

2 2015 Based on the aforementioned considerations, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence needs to be amended in its Articles and elucidation.

I. GENERAL

As a manifestation of the Regional Government's responsibility in taking actions both legally, politically, economically and socially to prevent, suppress, reduce, and eliminate all forms of violence against children and women, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence has been established.

Until now, the said Regional Regulation has been implemented in the administration of regional government. However, in accordance with the supervision mechanism for regional legal products, the Regional Government of the Special Region of Yogyakarta has provided clarification on Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence. From the results of said clarification, there are several substantive changes that must be followed up with an Amendment to the Regional Regulation.

2 2015 Based on the aforementioned considerations, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence needs to be amended in its Articles and elucidation.

I. GENERAL

As a manifestation of the Regional Government's responsibility in taking actions both legally, politically, economically and socially to prevent, suppress, reduce, and eliminate all forms of violence against children and women, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence has been established.

Until now, the said Regional Regulation has been implemented in the administration of regional government. However, in accordance with the supervision mechanism for regional legal products, the Regional Government of the Special Region of Yogyakarta has provided clarification on Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence. From the results of said clarification, there are several substantive changes that must be followed up with an Amendment to the Regional Regulation.

2 2015 Based on the aforementioned considerations, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence needs to be amended in its Articles and elucidation.

Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, and psychological, threat of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life against the victim. 10. Violence against women is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life. 11. Violence against children is any act that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, psychologically, sexually, neglect, exploitation, economically, and other violence. 12. Physical Violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and or causes death. 13. Psychological Violence is any act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person. 14. Sexual Violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse in an unnatural or unwanted manner, forced sexual intercourse with others for commercial purposes and or certain purposes. 15. Economic Violence is any act that neglects family members in the form of not providing proper living care or maintenance. 16. Exploitation of Children is any act involving children in activities that may harm their welfare and development or endanger the safety of children with the aim of enabling others to obtain economic, sexual, social, or political benefits, including if it contains restrictions or elimination of opportunities for children to obtain their rights. 17. Sexual harassment is any action with sexual nuances conveyed through physical or non-physical contact that targets sexual body parts or a person's sexuality, including by using whistles, winking, comments or sexually nuanced speech, displaying pornographic materials and sexual desires, pinching or touching body parts, movements or gestures that are sexual in nature resulting in feelings of discomfort, offense, feeling degraded in dignity, and possibly causing health and safety problems. 18. Protection of children is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination. 23. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred. 24.
